bot.title: n8n & Chatbot Integration
bot.description: Log your pain and symptoms directly from your preferred messaging app (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack) using n8n and AI agents.
bot.newKeyWarning: Copy this key now. For your security, it will NOT be shown again.
bot.howItWorks: How to set up your n8n workflow
bot.step1: 1. Create an n8n workflow with a Chat Trigger (Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, or Webhook).
bot.step2: 2. Pass the user's message to an AI Agent node instructed to extract pain characteristics.
bot.step3: 3. Add an HTTP Request tool/node calling POST /api/bot/symptom-entries with your X-API-Key header.
bot.step4: 4. Reply to the chat confirming the symptom has been logged in MedMatch!
